1. (Currently amended) A method of providing advertisements in a traffic message, implemented on a processor-based server system, comprising: - obtaining traffic data having a traffic condition of a location description on a road network; - assessing a location reference code associated with the location description assigned by a traffic message supplier; - assessing an advertising reference code associated with the location reference code; - determining whether the advertising reference code is present; and - generating a traffic message having the location reference code and the advertising reference code when the advertising reference code is present, wherein the traffic message is transmitted via the processor-based server system to navigation systems.
